message: Phew... I guess the porridge looks good enough like this?

name: Paqy
message: 「Yesterday, right. I had a crazy vivid wet dream. Since it was the Great Sage's own dream, it was one massive pink spectacle--wanna hear about it?」
The soft feel of a girl. The movement of her fingers. Her sweet scent.
I set the bowl down by the bedside of Azel, who has propped herself half-up from the futon.
It's awkward. I can't meet her eyes.
Skillfully keeping her gaze averted, Azel reaches out to take the bowl of porridge from me--
As she nearly drops it from the heat, I reach out my hand to steady it.
Our fingers overlap on the sides of the bowl.
Yesterday, Azel's body was close enough to touch.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I was just trying to steady it!」
Our fingers part, as if reluctant to let go.
Azel cradled the bowl carefully and began eating the rice porridge.
Um, conversation, conversation. Completely natural and casual.

name: Azel
message: 「Synn, y-you... well... since you're worried... I'll... stay in bed today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah. You really should get some rest.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine now. My fever went down, too. Still, I'm staying home all day today.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I see... I see... So you'll stay with me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, ah, yeah. Just call me if you need anything, okay.」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-you don't have to hold back on my account--you can go out if you want...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm staying. I don't have any errands anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... when you sleep... you wear your uniform... huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right... You do have a whole bunch of them...」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't have a bunch of them because I never wear the same thing twice... I-I mean... even I can do laundry...」

name: Azel
message: 「Having different kinds of clothes is... just a hassle...」

name: Azel
message: 「S-So yesterday's, um, those clothes too... I-I'll wash them myself...」
Azel's clothes and underwear are somewhere in this room.... Gulp.

name: Azel
message: 「T-Then fine... Y-You worry too much about me, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, of course I'm worried, but... I wouldn't just wash a girl's underwear without asking...」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I wouldn't do that either... I-It's irrational, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「N-No... I suppose it's rational for the one who can move to do the work... B-But I cannot accept that kind of rationality...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You want some tea, right!? It's just a second brew, though.」
As I tried to hand over the steaming teacup, our hands brushed.
I set the teacup down by her pillow.

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not that I dislike touching you or anything like that.」
Azel blushed all the way to her cheeks and looked down.

name: Azel
message: 「Even last night... um... I didn't feel... disgusted or anything... Though you might have felt defiled...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true! Not at all, not one bit!」
As soon as I blurted it out, my own cheeks grew hot.

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry... I shouldn't have said that so forcefully...」

name: Azel
message: 「The one acting strange... is probably me... I didn't hate it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on, Synn! What's the big idea!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can see that! Look, the heating isn't nearly enough, and it's way too dry in here! Though I figured it'd be like this.」
Nanaka pulled a hot water bottle out of her knapsack and placed it right against Azel's feet.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forget the thanks! Azel! What have you eaten since this morning?」
Nanaka thrust a piping-hot bowl of oyakodon right in front of Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「Right now... I don't have much of an appetite...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Put some plastic wrap on this oyakodon and stick it in the fridge! And take this!」

name: Synn
message: 「What am I... supposed to do with this?」
What Nanaka thrust at me was a pack of sake lees.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Amazake! I'm gonna whip some up right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see! We rarely have that around here, so it didn't even cross my mind!」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't blame... Synn. He's been taking good care of me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Boil some water while you're at it! And grab a towel too! I'm gonna wipe Azel down!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm gonna go hang out at Boss's place for a bit!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama! Hurry to the kitchen! I've got a bad feeling about this!」
Three bowls, licked clean without a single grain of rice left, were stacked in the kitchen.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, Sally's really started doing a lot more compared to how she used to be.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't get impressed over something that basic!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, I can't tell if Synn is thoughtful or clueless, or just broke... What a handful.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, he puts his all into everything he does, at least.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's boring when you have a cold, sure, but resting is the best thing for you!」

name: Azel
message: 「No. This physical body... Once something goes slightly wrong, it becomes difficult to move... It is flawed.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Flawed, huh... Well, I do wish they'd do something about that monthly thing.」

name: Azel
message: 「It engages in irrational behavior stemming from hardware defects, driven by incomprehensible and illogical impulses.」

name: Azel
message: 「Love or anything like that... is completely out of the question.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is Synn doing? He's taking forever.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am the reflection of Thy will. I am the vessel that sings Thy will.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am the thunderbolt. I am the spear. I am the gun. I am the proxy of Thy will.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am the chosen apostle. I am the prepared weapon. I am the signpost to the righteous path.」

name: Azel
message: 「I carry out. I destroy. I create. I usher in a new world.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am the chosen... proxy... so how could...」
